mainEntity.name: What utility connections are needed for a tiny home on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tiny home typically requires connections to essential utilities, similar to a traditional home. This includes electricity, water, and sewer or septic systems. The specific requirements can vary; some tiny homes can be connected to existing utility lines on your property, while others might require new hookups. Off-grid options, like solar power and composting toilets, can reduce reliance on traditional utility infrastructure, but still need to comply with local health and safety codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny homes need connections for electricity, water, and sewer/septic systems. Existing utility lines can be used, or new hookups might be necessary, with off-grid options also available.
